PC: Obtain full set of current vital signs
Inquire about respiratory status and I/Os for last 24 hours
Order chest x-ray, EKG; consider ABG if tachypneic, increased work of breathing
Discuss potential diuretics you will administer (furosemide 120mg IV bolus and/or drip)
SBP: Documentation: important to write an event note describing patient’s change in respiratory status, vitals, labs/imaging performed and assessment/plan including specific orders
ICS: Inform nurse that you will come see patient urgently and that their symptoms are most likely due to volume overload
